rollups.text: The user’s reading of The Poppy War trilogy developed from considering it after friend David recommended it in October 2023, to downloading it through Libby on 2023-12-07 and beginning its audiobook on 2023-12-10. On 2023-12-12, the user said they were enjoying it, chose it over The Broken Earth, and planned to combine audiobook listening during commutes with e-book reading at home. By 2024-01-20, the user had finished the 1,150-page trilogy in 12 days. Wyatt shared a 4.8-star review on 2023-12-03 and organized an online discussion on 2023-12-08; the user later hosted a discussion with Kelly on 2024-02-20, attended by 12 people, and described it as a success. Elapsed time from starting the audiobook to the reported finish: about 41 days; from the Libby download to the finish: about 44 days.

rollups.text: The user’s interest in The Expanse began on 2023-11-05, when the user welcomed its nine-book length as winter reading and asked about its pacing. On 2023-12-12, the user planned to sample the audiobook with Douglas during their commute. The user bought a print copy of Leviathan Wakes for $18 on 2024-01-19 and decided on 2024-01-20 to start the series, alternating morning print reading with audiobook listening on commutes with Douglas. By 2024-02-25, the user had finished the first three books, about 1,200 pages, and was on schedule with reading goals. Elapsed time from the first stated interest to the reported progress: 112 days.

Friend Megan recommended Andrzej Sapkowski’s The Witcher series to the user on 2024-02-10. The user borrowed Witcher e-books from Montserrat Public Library on 2024-02-12 and downloaded the first novel through Libby on 2024-02-13. On 2024-02-28, the user chose to start with The Last Wish and said the library borrowing meant no purchase was needed. The user had wondered whether they could finish the 450-page first novel before a planned 2024-02-27 literary event; on 2024-02-28, the user was scheduling weekday 8 PM reading blocks. Elapsed time from Megan’s recommendation to the stated choice to begin: 18 days.

On 2024-03-01, the user’s close friend Paul recommended Diana Gabaldon’s Outlander. The user ordered the paperback box set from Montserrat Books on 2024-03-05, using a 10% coupon and saving $6, and resumed Audible on 2024-03-12 to access the audiobooks narrated by Davina Porter. By 2024-03-15, the user had committed to reading the first four books, about 3,200 pages, by 2024-06-30, aiming for 40 pages daily and planning to alternate print and audio. The user also planned a discussion with Kelly. This record gives the commitment and plan, not confirmation that the books were completed.

On 2023-11-05, the user set a goal to finish at least three series by 2024-02-28 while averaging 350 pages per week. On 2023-12-12, the user described a Goodreads winter challenge goal of 10 books by 2024-03-01, later extending it to 12 books by that date. On 2024-01-20, the user again described a 10-book goal by 2024-03-01 while considering attending a literary festival. On 2024-03-10, the user reported finishing 11 books and surpassing the winter challenge. The records do not establish whether the original three-series goal was met. Elapsed time from the first series-goal date to the reported challenge result: 126 days.

The user said on 2023-11-05 that they were considering Audible after colleague Linda suggested it, and decided to try a free trial; no signup was confirmed then. The user subscribed to Audible’s $14.95 monthly plan on 2023-11-25. On 2023-12-12, the user chose a three-month prepaid plan after comparing the stated prices; the assistant calculated a $3 saving versus three monthly payments. The user paused the subscription on 2024-02-26 to reduce expenses and resumed it on 2024-03-12 to access Outlander audiobooks narrated by Davina Porter. Elapsed time from the confirmed subscription to the pause: 93 days; from the pause to resumption: 15 days.

The user’s Goodreads winter reading challenge goal changed from 10 books by 2024-03-01 to 12 books by the same deadline, as stated on 2023-12-12. On 2024-03-10, the user reported completing 11 books and surpassing the challenge. The records therefore show a final reported total of 11, not completion of the revised 12-book target.

rollups.text: The user’s confirmed reading-format routines and preferences changed and expanded over time: on 2023-12-12, the user chose print or e-books during the day and audiobooks in the evening after 8 PM to reduce eye strain; the user also valued audiobooks for multitasking and print for immersive weekend reading. On 2024-01-20, the user planned print reading in the mornings and audiobooks during commutes with Douglas for The Expanse, and said having both formats offered different ways to enjoy Leviathan Wakes. On 2024-03-15, the user planned to alternate print and audiobook editions for Outlander. The user also prefers e-books for portability, while appreciating print for tactile reading, collecting, and gifting.

Confirmed book-related purchases and spending reports: on 2023-12-02, the user bought a $25 boxed set of The Poppy War trilogy from Montserrat Books as a gift. On 2024-01-19, the user bought a print copy of Leviathan Wakes for $18. On 2024-01-20, the user reported spending $43 on books and subscriptions against a $35 January budget, $8 over budget; the user planned to be more careful in February. On 2024-02-28, the user reported a $35 February budget and $28 already spent, leaving $7. On 2024-03-05, the user ordered the Outlander paperback box set from Montserrat Books for $55 with free shipping and used a 10% coupon, saving $6. A separate record says the user later described an April–June 2024 book budget of $60, while another described an increased $75 budget; the records do not resolve the discrepancy.

The user’s confirmed or seriously planned reading titles include The Poppy War trilogy (downloaded 2023-12-07, audiobook started 2023-12-10, reported finished by 2024-01-20); Leviathan Wakes (print copy bought 2024-01-19 and The Expanse series started by 2024-01-20); The Nightingale by Kristin Hannah (finished by 2024-02-28 and rated five stars on Goodreads on 2024-03-15); The Witcher, beginning with The Last Wish (borrowed or downloaded in February 2024 and chosen to start on 2024-02-28); and Outlander by Diana Gabaldon (box set ordered 2024-03-05; first four books planned by 2024-06-30). Other stated prospective choices include The Hundred Thousand Kingdoms by N. K. Jemisin as a next e-book on 2024-01-20 and The Thursday Murder Club by Richard Osman as a relaxing e-book choice on 2024-01-20; the records do not confirm that either was started.

The user hosted a discussion of The Poppy War with Kelly on 2024-02-20. Twelve people attended, and the user described the discussion as a great success. This is the only confirmed attendance count for the user’s book-club discussions in these records.
